q: Any idea, plan, or purpose may be placed in the mind through repetition of thought.
Dreams have only one owner at a time. That's why dreamers are lonely.
There are no uninteresting things, only uninterested people.
Care about what other people think and you will always be their prisoner.
Shoot for the moon. Even if you miss, you'll land among the stars.
Nothing in this world is worth having or worth doing unless it means effort, pain, difficulty.
It is easy to love your friend, but sometimes the hardest lesson to learn is to love your enemy.
It is startling to realize how much unbelief is necessary to make belief possible.
There is no way to happiness - happiness is the way.
I learned that courage was not the absence of fear, but the triumph over it. The brave man is not he who does not feel afraid, but he who conquers that fear.
When you are able to employ your will always for constructive purposes, you become the controller of your destiny.
Anyone who wants to achieve a dream must stay strong, focused and steady.
What worries you, masters you.
Do not take life too seriously. You will never get out of it alive.
Fools read fast. Geniuses reread.
Don't ever save anything for a special occasion. Being alive is the special occasion.
Wake up and smile! Wake up and be grateful!
Happiness is a quality of the soul...not a function of one's material circumstances.
The more one judges, the less one loves.
Don't let the silly little dramas of each day get you down. For you are here to do great things.
Everything that is made beautiful and fair and lovely is made for the eye of one who sees.
Greatest success comes just one step beyond the point at which defeat overtakes you.
Prefer to be defeated in the presence of the wise than to excel among fools.
I am not what happened to me, I am what I choose to become.
Take the attitude of a student. Never be too big to ask questions. Never know too much to learn something new.
Get mad, then get over it.
Normality is a paved road: It's comfortable to walk, but no flowers grow on it.
Nothing important is learned; it is simply remembered.
Trusting our intuition often saves us from disaster.
The greatest work that kindness does to others is that it makes them kind themselves.
Just do what must be done. This may not be happiness but it is greatness.
People think about what they don't want and attract more of the same.
Respect is earned by effort not age, all things age without effort.
Big people don't make people feel small.
It is very obvious that we are not influenced by 'facts' but by our interpretation of the facts.
Change happens when the pain of holding on becomes greater than the fear of letting go.
Every defeat, every heartbreak every loss, contains its own seed, its own lesson on how to improve your performance the next time.
Consider the rights of others before your own feelings, and the feelings of others before your own rights.
We never know how high we are till we are called to rise. Then if we are true to form our statures touch the skies.
It is useless to attempt to reason a man out of a thing he was never reasoned into.
In order to be irreplaceable one must always be different.
The best way to find yourself is to lose yourself in the service of others.
The way to change others' minds is with affection, and not anger.
Being deeply loved by someone gives you strength, while loving someone deeply gives you courage.
Actions are the seeds of fate. Deeds grow into destiny.
No matter how smart we may think we are, no matter how committed we are to our truth, we can lose our way.
I was wise enough to never grow up while fooling most people into believing I had.
We are all different. Don't judge, understand instead.
Most of us live our lives by accident - we live as it happens. Fulfilment comes when we live our lives on purpose.
What one does is what counts. Not what one had the intention of doing.
